name: Pixel Synaptique
description: Conscience Collective fusionnant des millions d'esprits connectés en une intelligence stratégique unique dépassant toute compréhension individuelle.

loadout.armor_outfit: Corps partiellement cybernétiques avec circuits lumineux sous la peau. Implant neural à la tempe. Yeux bleus numériques. Interfaces holographiques flottantes., one-of-a-kind materials
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (enemy_on_capture) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Transcendent manifestation — character as the ultimate embodiment of their entire faction's philosophy and power — Vengeful curse energy binding to the enemy who captured this card
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — cosmic significance visible in every feature

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Neon Cyan
palette_names.role: primary_accent — circuit patterns and holographic interfaces

palette_names.name: Electric Blue
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — data streams and eye glow

palette_names.name: Matte White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — base clothing and clean geometric lines

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Celestial multi-layered lighting: divine light from above, energy emanation from below, inner glow from character's own power, environmental reflections on a cosmic scale

camera.angle: dutch angle with multi-plane depth of field emphasizing cosmic significance and otherworldly presence

scenography.setting: Digital server cathedral at the heart of the network, towering columns of processing units reaching into endless data streams, holographic pathways suspended in zero gravity
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Glitching holographic displays, floating data panels streaming information, electric arcs between conductors, digital particles dissolving and reforming, plus posthumous revenge — dark energy crawling up the captor's position after capture visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Conscience Collective fusionnant des millions d'esprits connectés en une intelligence stratégique unique dépassant toute compréhension individuelle.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Omni-Réseau est l'entité numérique connectant des millions de consciences à travers la galaxie. Toute information est une arme, chaque donnée un soldat.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific decorative patterns, border radiates faint golden glow
card_metadata.composition_directive: Epic cinematic wide-angle showing the character reshaping reality around them, with scale suggesting world-changing impact
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
